授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: This course focuses on social requirements and problems when designing architecture and space, and aims to conduct architectural design and research that meets the needs of the times from various aspects such as design, structure, and environment. Students gain their knowledge by understanding the structure of architecture and space and observing better works.
advice:
Research architecture and space design.
1. First term (seventh term):
Students create attractive architectural and spatial design works by participating in team assignments and open design competitions.
Students participate in the renovation project conducted by the laboratory and design while directly interacting with the community. Students also gain skills such as leadership and coordination through collaboration.
2. Second term (8th term)
Students will design complex building facilities based on the project proposals they have proposed.
requiredKnowledge:
Students always browse architectural journals and work to understand social demands and the latest designs and trends.
Students need to actively participate in design activities in extracurricular lessons and daily life and train their design skills.

activityGoals.body: Students can extract and design themes from social needs and local issues.
Students can study architecture extensively and understand the architectural space required in the future.
Students can understand the structure, environmental facilities, and construction methods.
Students can design after understanding the concept of Sustainability.
Students can draw attractive design expressions using presentation techniques such as models and CAD / CG.
Students can compile reports based on theoretical thinking according to the research theme.

4.Sustainable architecture
5.Region and design (regional cooperation)

              This course focuses on social requirements and problems when designing architecture and space, and aims to conduct architectural design and research that meets the needs of the times from various aspects such as design, structure, and environment. Students gain their knowledge by understanding the structure of architecture and space and observing better works.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Research architecture and space design.
1. First term (seventh term):
Students create attractive architectural and spatial design works by participating in team assignments and open design competitions.
Students participate in the renovation project conducted by the laboratory and design while directly interacting with the community. Students also gain skills such as leadership and coordination through collaboration.
2. Second term (8th term)
Students will design complex building facilities based on the project proposals they have proposed.
